description: Returns structured public evidence and explicit unknowns. Coupon code candidates published in the homepage metadata of a shop, with the source text. Codes are not verified at checkout. $0.01 per non-empty result. Use to collect possible discounts before checkout; use universal_product_url_to_json for product prices and availability. Does not apply coupons or place an order.
